title: Return requests
description: Handle returns, exchanges and refund requests.

help.title: About return requests
help.overview: A customer asks to return goods, exchange them or get money back for an order. Customers ask from their account; you can also create a request here.

sections.title: What can be claimed
items: Only items that have shipped and are not in another open request. The refund can't be more than those items are worth.
Till sales are refunded on the till, not here.
Your team is told when a new request comes in.

sections.title: Step by step
items: Approve or Reject. Approving can set the refund amount. The customer is told either way.
Mark received when the goods are back: returned or exchanged items go back into stock in the warehouse they left from. A refund-only request has nothing to receive; marking it moves it on.
Complete pays the refund, back to the card for card payments. An exchange pays nothing back: send the replacement separately.
